The healthcare Q&A matches suggest that the answer to whether endothelial cell patterns of astrocytomas are indicative of grade is as follows:

Evaluation of astrocytomas utilizing antibody to vWF and confocal microscopy aids in the grading of these neoplasms.

This means that the presence and intensity of endothelial cell patterns can be used as one factor in determining the grade of astrocytoma. However, it's essential to note that this is just one aspect of the grading process, and other factors may also be considered when assessing the grade of an astrocytoma.
